why: An empty result is where an agent invents. `note` is declared by this corpus and holds no instances — that is the entire reason the class is here — and a server that answers zero rows without saying which kind of zero has handed a caller something indistinguishable from a bad embedding, a typo it already ruled out, and a corpus that genuinely has no view. `absence.instances` is 0 because the class is empty, and `elsewhere` is an empty list rather than absent so a client never distinguishes `no dependency holds it` from `nothing looked`. This corpus has no dependencies, so there is nothing to name.
